title: Canonical capability semantic profile
root_cause: Capability routing lacks one complete semantic contract and derives intent almost exclusively from contract.provides.
source_requirement: Normalize positive/negative intents, domains, mechanisms, I/O, effects, exclusions, synonyms, ambiguity guards, failure modes, and maturity.
implementation_steps: Define canonical schema and deterministic normalizer.
Map current skill metadata/contracts without inventing unsupported intent.
rollback: Remove the semantic profile adapter while preserving source skill metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Every active routable skill can produce one valid semantic profile.
Profiles distinguish negative intent and ambiguity.
